name: Venomancer Chitinous Spikes granted by non-periodic crits (#2920)
contract: #2920: Chitinous Spikes talent 705987 (Proc Trigger Spell, 'Causes non-periodic critical strikes to grant Chitinous Spikes') ships without a spell_proc row, so the buff 705986 never applies. The row mirrors the sibling crit proc 705982 (all direct damage, HitMask 2 = PROC_HIT_CRITICAL); aura_ascension_venomancer_event narrows it to non-periodic crits and casts 705986 on the player. The buff itself is native: aura 285 MOD_ATTACK_POWER_OF_ARMOR plus a damage shield. Fixture forces crits with melee_crit_rating so a normal hit cannot pass the grant assertion and a periodic tick cannot grant it (script excludes periodic).

steps.label: No Chitinous Spikes before any crit
A melee crit grants Chitinous Spikes
